title: My First Presentation
description: A short story about turning nervous energy into a confident first step.
description_zh: 一个把紧张转化为勇敢第一步的小故事。

units.text: On Monday morning, I gave my first presentation to the whole team.
units.translation: 星期一早上，我第一次向整个团队做了演讲。

units.text: My hands were shaking, so I paused and took one slow breath.
units.translation: 我的双手在发抖，于是我停下来，慢慢地吸了一口气。

units.text: Instead of reading every word, I looked up and spoke to the people in the room.
units.translation: 我没有逐字照读，而是抬起头，对着房间里的人说话。

units.text: A colleague nodded, and that small sign helped me feel more confident.
units.translation: 一位同事点了点头，这个小小的回应让我更加自信。

units.text: When I finished, I realized that starting was the hardest part.
units.translation: 结束时我才意识到，开始其实是最难的部分。
